<!--
PURPOSE
This notebook does NOT reproduce or alter any of notebook 01's outputs, and does NOT touch or
re-derive notebook 00's cohort-building logic. cohort_hospitalization_ids is treated purely as a
fixed, already-built input, exactly as notebook 01 treats it - this QC is scoped strictly to
notebook 01's own filtering/joining logic.

It exists only to diagnose why a site's ICD-10-PCS proning/ventilation codes, which are confirmed
present in the raw clif_patient_procedures table, are not showing up as matches in notebook 01's
final joined_df (any_proning_icd / any_ventilation_icd).

Every check below is tagged [PASS] / [WARN] / [FAIL] / [INFO] so the log is self-explanatory
without needing to re-read this notebook:
  [PASS] - this step behaves as expected, not the cause of the problem
  [WARN] - a real formatting/data issue was found, but it may or may not fully explain the symptom
  [FAIL] - this step reproduces notebook 01's own stop()/zero-row failure mode - strong candidate
  [INFO] - informational context, not a pass/fail judgment

It re-runs notebook 01's exact filtering/joining pipeline one step at a time and records ONLY
aggregate row counts (and a small number of de-identified diagnostic flags) at each step into a
single plain-text QC log file - no patient-level data is written anywhere.

Please knit/run this top to bottom, then send back the generated log file (printed path at the
end of the run).
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
packages <- c("dplyr", "arrow", "yaml", "rprojroot", "stringr", "lubridate", "data.table")

install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
invisible(sapply(packages, install_if_missing))
rm(packages, install_if_missing)

select <- dplyr::select

project_root <- file.path(find_root(rprojroot::has_dir("CLIF_Proning_ICD10_Validation")),
                           "CLIF_Proning_ICD10_Validation")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

config <- yaml::read_yaml(paste0(project_root, '/config/config.yaml'))
site             <- tolower(config$site)
tables_location  <- config$clif_data_path
project_location <- config$project_location

setwd(project_location)

# Log Accumulator - Every Diagnostic Line Goes Here Instead of Console/cat(), So the Entire Run
# Can Be Written to a Single File the Site Sends Back
qc_log <- character(0)
log_line <- function(...) {
  qc_log <<- c(qc_log, paste0(...))
}
log_blank <- function() {
  qc_log <<- c(qc_log, "")
}
# Tagged Status Line - status Must Be One of PASS / WARN / FAIL / INFO
log_status <- function(status, ...) {
  if (!status %in% c("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL", "INFO")) {
    stop("log_status() called with invalid status: ", status)
  }
  qc_log <<- c(qc_log, paste0("[", status, "] ", paste0(...)))
}
```

```{r Same Hardcoded Parameters as Notebook 01}
cohort_year_cutoff <- 2023

proning_codes <- c("5A09B5K", "5A09C5K", "5A09D5K")
proning_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(proning_codes, collapse = "|"), ")")
proning_code_map <- c(
  "5A09B5K" = "Assistance with Resp Ventilation, <8 Hrs, Intub Prone",
  "5A09C5K" = "Assistance with Resp Ventilation, 8-24 Hrs, Intub Prone",
  "5A09D5K" = "Assistance with Resp Ventilation, >24 Hrs, Intub Prone"
)

ventilation_codes <- c("5A1935Z", "5A1945Z", "5A1955Z")
ventilation_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(ventilation_codes, collapse = "|"), ")")
ventilation_code_map <- c(
  "5A1935Z" = "Respiratory Ventilation, Less Than 24 Consecutive Hours",
  "5A1945Z" = "Respiratory Ventilation, 24-96 Consecutive Hours",
  "5A1955Z" = "Respiratory Ventilation, Greater Than 96 Consecutive Hours"
)

path_patient_procedures <- paste0(tables_location, '/clif_patient_procedures.parquet')
path_hospital_diagnosis <- paste0(tables_location, '/clif_hospital_diagnosis.parquet')
path_cohort_hosp_ids     <- paste0(project_location, '/project_tables/cohort_hospitalization_ids.RData')

### Output Path for QC Log ---------------------------------------------------------
icd_qc_log_dir  <- paste0(project_location, "/project_output/icd_qc_log")
if (!dir.exists(icd_qc_log_dir)) dir.create(icd_qc_log_dir, recursive = TRUE)
path_out_qc_log <- paste0(icd_qc_log_dir, '/', site, '_icd_matching_qc_log.txt')

log_line("ICD MATCHING QC LOG - site: ", site, " - generated: ", as.character(Sys.time()))
log_line("No patient-level data is included below - aggregate counts and PASS/WARN/FAIL/INFO flags only.")
log_blank()
```

```{r Load Cohort Hospitalization IDs and Check Its Own Integrity}
load(path_cohort_hosp_ids)

log_line("== Section A: Cohort Hospitalization IDs Table (treated as fixed input from notebook 00) ==")
log_status("INFO", "n rows = ", nrow(cohort_hospitalization_ids),
           " | n distinct hospitalization_id = ", n_distinct(cohort_hospitalization_ids$hospitalization_id))
log_status("INFO", "class(hospitalization_id) in cohort table: ", class(cohort_hospitalization_ids$hospitalization_id))

# QC: Replicates Notebook 01's Own Duplicate-hospitalization_id Warning (its 'Load Cohort
# Hospitalization IDs' chunk) - a Duplicate Here Fans Out the proning_icd/ventilation_icd Joins
dup_check <- cohort_hospitalization_ids |> count(hospitalization_id) |> filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(dup_check) > 0) {
  log_status("FAIL", nrow(dup_check), " duplicate hospitalization_id value(s) found in cohort_hospitalization_ids. ",
             "Notebook 01 itself warns about this - duplicates can misattribute ICD billing codes across patients ",
             "in the proning_icd/ventilation_icd joins.")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "No duplicate hospitalization_id values in cohort_hospitalization_ids.")
}

# QC: Does the cohort table itself contain whitespace/case inconsistencies that would make an
# otherwise-matching hospitalization_id fail an exact string join?
cohort_raw_distinct   <- n_distinct(cohort_hospitalization_ids$hospitalization_id)
cohort_norm_distinct  <- n_distinct(toupper(trimws(as.character(cohort_hospitalization_ids$hospitalization_id))))
if (cohort_raw_distinct != cohort_norm_distinct) {
  log_status("WARN", "cohort_hospitalization_ids contains whitespace/case variants of the same ID (",
             cohort_raw_distinct, " raw distinct vs ", cohort_norm_distinct, " normalized distinct) - ",
             "could independently cause missed exact-string joins regardless of the procedures table.")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "No whitespace/case variants detected within cohort_hospitalization_ids ",
             "(raw distinct = normalized distinct = ", cohort_raw_distinct, ").")
}
log_blank()

cohort_hospitalization_ids <- cohort_hospitalization_ids |>
  mutate(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id))
cohort_ids_exact <- cohort_hospitalization_ids$hospitalization_id
```

```{r Section B - Raw Code Matches in clif_patient_procedures, Format Filter Isolated From Pattern Filter}
procs_raw <- open_dataset(path_patient_procedures) |> collect()

log_line("== Section B: clif_patient_procedures Raw Match Breakdown ==")
log_status("INFO", "total n rows = ", nrow(procs_raw))

# QC: Missingness That Would Silently Break grepl()/toupper() or the hospitalization_id Join
n_na_code <- sum(is.na(procs_raw$procedure_code) | trimws(procs_raw$procedure_code) == "")
n_na_fmt  <- sum(is.na(procs_raw$procedure_code_format) | trimws(procs_raw$procedure_code_format) == "")
n_na_hosp <- sum(is.na(procs_raw$hospitalization_id))
if (n_na_code > 0 || n_na_fmt > 0 || n_na_hosp > 0) {
  log_status("WARN", "Missing/blank values found - procedure_code: ", n_na_code,
             " | procedure_code_format: ", n_na_fmt, " | hospitalization_id: ", n_na_hosp,
             " (rows with these missing cannot match regardless of case-sensitivity).")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "No missing/blank procedure_code, procedure_code_format, or hospitalization_id values.")
}

fmt_counts <- procs_raw |> count(fmt = toupper(procedure_code_format), sort = TRUE)
log_status("INFO", "Distinct procedure_code_format values (uppercased):")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fmt_counts))) {
  log_line("  ", fmt_counts$fmt[i], ": ", fmt_counts$n[i])
}

n_fmt_only     <- procs_raw |> filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS")) |> nrow()
n_pattern_only_prone <- procs_raw |> filter(grepl(proning_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |> nrow()
n_pattern_only_vent  <- procs_raw |> filter(grepl(ventilation_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |> nrow()
n_both_prone   <- procs_raw |> filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
                                       grepl(proning_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |> nrow()
n_both_vent    <- procs_raw |> filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
                                       grepl(ventilation_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |> nrow()

log_blank()
if (n_fmt_only == 0) {
  log_status("FAIL", "Zero rows match procedure_code_format %in% c('ICD10PCS','ICD-10-PCS') after toupper(). ",
             "Check the distinct format values logged above against notebook 01's hardcoded list - this alone ",
             "would zero out every downstream match regardless of procedure_code content.")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "Rows passing format filter alone: ", n_fmt_only)
}

if (n_both_prone == 0) {
  log_status("FAIL", "Zero rows pass BOTH format + proning pattern filter (raw match total). ",
             "Notebook 01 would hit its own stop() here ('No ICD-10-PCS proning codes found').")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "Rows passing BOTH (format + proning pattern): ", n_both_prone,
             "  <- should match notebook 01's proning_counts_proc total")
}

if (n_both_vent == 0) {
  log_status("FAIL", "Zero rows pass BOTH format + ventilation pattern filter (raw match total).")
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "Rows passing BOTH (format + ventilation pattern): ", n_both_vent,
             "  <- should match notebook 01's vent raw count")
}
log_blank()

# QC: Per-Exact-Code Breakdown - Notebook 01's Actual Flags (proning_lt8h/8_24h/gt24h,
# vent_lt24h/24_96h/gt96h) Are Derived From Exact Code Equality, Not Just the Combined Pattern, So
# This Reports Each Individual Code's Count Under the Same Format+Case-Insensitive-Match Filter
log_line("Per-exact-code raw counts (format filter + exact code match, case-insensitive):")
for (code in proning_codes) {
  n_code <- procs_raw |>
    filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
           toupper(procedure_code) == code) |>
    nrow()
  status <- if (n_code == 0) "FAIL" else "PASS"
  log_status(status, code, " (", proning_code_map[[code]], "): ", n_code,
             ifelse(n_code == 0, " - code genuinely absent from raw table under this format filter", ""))
}
for (code in ventilation_codes) {
  n_code <- procs_raw |>
    filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
           toupper(procedure_code) == code) |>
    nrow()
  status <- if (n_code == 0) "FAIL" else "PASS"
  log_status(status, code, " (", ventilation_code_map[[code]], "): ", n_code,
             ifelse(n_code == 0, " - code genuinely absent from raw table under this format filter", ""))
}
log_blank()
```

```{r Section C - Replicate Notebook 01s larger_proning_table Table-Selection Logic}
# Notebook 01 compares raw proning-code match counts in clif_patient_procedures vs
# clif_hospital_diagnosis, and stop()s the ENTIRE notebook if clif_hospital_diagnosis wins (its
# downstream code only supports the clif_patient_procedures schema). If this site's data would
# trigger that tie-break differently than other sites, notebook 01 would halt with an error before
# ever reaching the ICD-flag derivation chunks - a full, non-silent explanation for "no ICD code
# matched" if what the site is actually seeing is an uncaught error rather than empty output.

log_line("== Section C: larger_proning_table Selection (notebook 01's table tie-break logic) ==")

dx_raw <- open_dataset(path_hospital_diagnosis) |> collect()
n_dx_prone <- dx_raw |> filter(grepl(proning_pattern, diagnosis_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |> nrow()

log_status("INFO", "clif_hospital_diagnosis proning-code raw match count: ", n_dx_prone)
log_status("INFO", "clif_patient_procedures proning-code raw match count: ", n_both_prone)

if (n_both_prone == 0 && n_dx_prone == 0) {
  log_status("FAIL", "No proning ICD-10-PCS codes found in EITHER table - notebook 01's stop() at the ",
             "'See which table is bigger' chunk would halt the entire notebook here.")
  larger_proning_table <- NA_character_
} else if (n_dx_prone > n_both_prone) {
  log_status("FAIL", "clif_hospital_diagnosis has more proning-code matches (", n_dx_prone,
             ") than clif_patient_procedures (", n_both_prone, "). Notebook 01's tie-break would select ",
             "clif_hospital_diagnosis as larger_proning_table, which its downstream code does NOT support ",
             "and will stop() with 'larger_proning_table resolved to...'. If the site is seeing an uncaught ",
             "error rather than silent zero matches, THIS is almost certainly the cause.")
  larger_proning_table <- "clif_hospital_diagnosis"
} else {
  log_status("PASS", "clif_patient_procedures has >= as many proning-code matches as clif_hospital_diagnosis (",
             n_both_prone, " vs ", n_dx_prone, ") - notebook 01 would correctly select clif_patient_procedures.")
  larger_proning_table <- "clif_patient_procedures"
}
log_blank()
```

```{r Section D - Replicate Notebook 01s Exact hospitalization_id Join Mechanics}
# This replicates notebook 01's proning_icd/ventilation_icd chunks (lines ~478-528) exactly,
# INCLUDING the order of operations: semi_join() is performed on the LAZY Arrow Dataset object
# (before collect()), not on an in-memory data frame. This is checked separately against the
# pure in-memory/R equivalent below, since an Arrow/dplyr backend quirk could in principle make
# the lazy join behave differently without raising any error.

log_line("== Section D: hospitalization_id Join to Cohort Table ==")

matched_proning <- procs_raw |>
  filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
         grepl(proning_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(procedure_code = toupper(procedure_code),
         hospitalization_id_chr = as.character(hospitalization_id))

matched_vent <- procs_raw |>
  filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
         grepl(ventilation_pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(procedure_code = toupper(procedure_code),
         hospitalization_id_chr = as.character(hospitalization_id))

log_status("INFO", "class(hospitalization_id) in clif_patient_procedures (before as.character): ",
           class(procs_raw$hospitalization_id))

for (lbl in c("proning", "ventilation")) {
  df <- if (lbl == "proning") matched_proning else matched_vent
  ids <- unique(df$hospitalization_id_chr)

  n_exact_match <- sum(ids %in% cohort_ids_exact)
  n_trim_match  <- sum(trimws(ids) %in% trimws(cohort_ids_exact))
  n_norm_match  <- sum(toupper(trimws(ids)) %in% toupper(trimws(cohort_ids_exact)))

  log_status("INFO", "[", lbl, "] distinct matched hospitalization_ids: ", length(ids))

  if (n_exact_match == length(ids)) {
    log_status("PASS", "[", lbl, "] exact string match to cohort table: ", n_exact_match, " / ", length(ids))
  } else if (n_norm_match > n_exact_match) {
    log_status("WARN", "[", lbl, "] exact match only ", n_exact_match, " / ", length(ids),
               ", but trimws()+toupper() recovers ", n_norm_match, " / ", length(ids),
               " - MISMATCH IS WHITESPACE/CASE FORMATTING IN hospitalization_id, NOT A REAL COHORT EXCLUSION. ",
               "Fix: normalize (trimws+toupper) hospitalization_id before the semi_join in notebook 01.")
  } else {
    log_status("INFO", "[", lbl, "] exact match: ", n_exact_match, " / ", length(ids),
               " (unchanged after trimws()+toupper() normalization)")
  }

  n_unmatched_after_norm <- length(ids) - n_norm_match
  if (n_unmatched_after_norm > 0) {
    log_status("WARN", "[", lbl, "] ", n_unmatched_after_norm, " / ", length(ids),
               " matched hospitalization_ids are not found in cohort_hospitalization_ids under any ",
               "normalization - out of this QC's scope to say why (cohort_hospitalization_ids is treated ",
               "as a fixed input from notebook 00). See Section E to check if these are legitimately ",
               "pre-cohort-cutoff.")
  }
  log_blank()
}
```

```{r Section E - Reproduce Notebook 01s Lazy Arrow semi_join vs Pure In-Memory R Join}
# Directly tests whether Arrow's dplyr backend (joining a lazy open_dataset() object against an
# in-memory tibble, as notebook 01 does) returns a different row count than the logically
# equivalent pure-R join on already-collected data. A mismatch here would point to an
# Arrow/dplyr version-specific backend quirk at this site as the root cause, independent of any
# ID formatting issue already checked in Section D.

log_line("== Section E: Arrow-Lazy-Dataset Join vs In-Memory R Join (exact notebook 01 code path) ==")

if (!is.na(larger_proning_table) && larger_proning_table == "clif_patient_procedures") {

  arrow_join_count <- function(path, pattern) {
    open_dataset(path) |>
      mutate(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id)) |>
      dplyr::semi_join(cohort_hospitalization_ids, by = "hospitalization_id") |>
      collect() |>
      filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"),
             grepl(pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
      nrow()
  }

  r_join_count <- function(df, pattern) {
    df |>
      filter(grepl(pattern, procedure_code, ignore.case = TRUE),
             hospitalization_id_chr %in% cohort_ids_exact) |>
      nrow()
  }

  arrow_prone_n <- arrow_join_count(path_patient_procedures, proning_pattern)
  r_prone_n     <- r_join_count(matched_proning, proning_pattern)
  arrow_vent_n  <- arrow_join_count(path_patient_procedures, ventilation_pattern)
  r_vent_n      <- r_join_count(matched_vent, ventilation_pattern)

  if (arrow_prone_n == r_prone_n) {
    log_status("PASS", "[proning] Arrow-lazy semi_join row count (", arrow_prone_n,
               ") matches in-memory R join row count (", r_prone_n, ").")
  } else {
    log_status("FAIL", "[proning] Arrow-lazy semi_join row count (", arrow_prone_n,
               ") DOES NOT MATCH in-memory R join row count (", r_prone_n, "). This points to an ",
               "Arrow/dplyr backend quirk (likely tied to this site's installed 'arrow' package version) ",
               "silently diverging from notebook 01's expected join behavior.")
  }

  if (arrow_vent_n == r_vent_n) {
    log_status("PASS", "[ventilation] Arrow-lazy semi_join row count (", arrow_vent_n,
               ") matches in-memory R join row count (", r_vent_n, ").")
  } else {
    log_status("FAIL", "[ventilation] Arrow-lazy semi_join row count (", arrow_vent_n,
               ") DOES NOT MATCH in-memory R join row count (", r_vent_n, "). This points to an ",
               "Arrow/dplyr backend quirk (likely tied to this site's installed 'arrow' package version) ",
               "silently diverging from notebook 01's expected join behavior.")
  }

} else {
  log_status("INFO", "Skipped - Section C resolved larger_proning_table away from clif_patient_procedures, ",
             "so notebook 01 would stop() before reaching this join (see Section C).")
}
log_blank()
```

```{r Section F - Per-Exact-Code Counts After the Full Notebook 01 Equivalent Pipeline}
# This is what actually feeds notebook 01's final flags (proning_lt8h/8_24h/gt24h,
# vent_lt24h/24_96h/gt96h). Compare these numbers to Section B's raw per-code counts to see
# exactly how many of each code survive the cohort restriction.

log_line("== Section F: Per-Exact-Code Counts AFTER Cohort Join (feeds notebook 01's final flags) ==")

for (code in proning_codes) {
  n_raw  <- procs_raw |>
    filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"), toupper(procedure_code) == code) |>
    nrow()
  n_code <- matched_proning |>
    filter(procedure_code == code, hospitalization_id_chr %in% cohort_ids_exact) |>
    nrow()
  status <- if (n_raw > 0 && n_code == 0) "FAIL" else if (n_raw > 0 && n_code < n_raw) "WARN" else "PASS"
  log_status(status, code, " (", proning_code_map[[code]], "): raw = ", n_raw, " -> after cohort join = ", n_code)
}
for (code in ventilation_codes) {
  n_raw  <- procs_raw |>
    filter(toupper(procedure_code_format) %in% c("ICD10PCS", "ICD-10-PCS"), toupper(procedure_code) == code) |>
    nrow()
  n_code <- matched_vent |>
    filter(procedure_code == code, hospitalization_id_chr %in% cohort_ids_exact) |>
    nrow()
  status <- if (n_raw > 0 && n_code == 0) "FAIL" else if (n_raw > 0 && n_code < n_raw) "WARN" else "PASS"
  log_status(status, code, " (", ventilation_code_map[[code]], "): raw = ", n_raw, " -> after cohort join = ", n_code)
}
log_blank()
```

```{r Section G - Rule Out Date-Based Exclusion}
# Confirms matched ICD rows are not simply pre-dating the cohort_year_cutoff / earliest-billing
# cutoff notebook 01 applies, which would be a legitimate (non-bug) reason for zero downstream
# matches rather than a defect anywhere in the pipeline above.

log_line("== Section G: Date-Based Exclusion Check ==")

for (lbl in c("proning", "ventilation")) {
  df <- if (lbl == "proning") matched_proning else matched_vent
  n_na_dt <- sum(is.na(df$procedure_billed_dttm))
  yrs <- year(df$procedure_billed_dttm)
  yr_tab <- table(yrs, useNA = "ifany")

  if (n_na_dt == nrow(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
    log_status("FAIL", "[", lbl, "] procedure_billed_dttm is NA for ALL ", nrow(df), " matched rows - ",
               "notebook 01's earliest_procedure_billed_dttm (min(..., na.rm=TRUE)) would resolve to NA/Inf, ",
               "which silently filters the entire cohort to zero rows downstream.")
  } else if (n_na_dt > 0) {
    log_status("WARN", "[", lbl, "] procedure_billed_dttm is NA for ", n_na_dt, " / ", nrow(df), " matched rows.")
  } else {
    log_status("PASS", "[", lbl, "] procedure_billed_dttm populated for all matched rows.")
  }

  log_status("INFO", "[", lbl, "] procedure_billed_dttm year distribution:")
  for (yr_name in names(yr_tab)) {
    log_line("  ", yr_name, ": ", yr_tab[[yr_name]])
  }

  n_pre_cutoff <- sum(yrs < cohort_year_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (n_pre_cutoff > 0) {
    log_status("WARN", "[", lbl, "] ", n_pre_cutoff, " / ", nrow(df), " matched rows pre-date cohort_year_cutoff (",
               cohort_year_cutoff, ") and would be legitimately excluded by notebook 01's ",
               "'Filter Dataset Only to After The First Instance of Billing' step.")
  } else {
    log_status("PASS", "[", lbl, "] No matched rows pre-date cohort_year_cutoff (", cohort_year_cutoff, ").")
  }
  log_blank()
}
```

```{r Write QC Log to File}
n_fail <- sum(grepl("^\\[FAIL\\]", qc_log))
n_warn <- sum(grepl("^\\[WARN\\]", qc_log))
n_pass <- sum(grepl("^\\[PASS\\]", qc_log))

log_line("== SUMMARY ==")
log_line("PASS: ", n_pass, "  |  WARN: ", n_warn, "  |  FAIL: ", n_fail)
log_blank()
if (n_fail > 0) {
  log_line("FAIL lines found above - these reproduce one of notebook 01's own stop()/zero-row failure")
  log_line("modes and are the strongest candidates for the root cause. Review them first, in order.")
} else if (n_warn > 0) {
  log_line("No FAIL lines, but WARN lines were found - review these for formatting mismatches or")
  log_line("legitimate (non-bug) cohort-eligibility exclusions.")
} else {
  log_line("All checks PASSED - this QC notebook could not reproduce the zero-match symptom using")
  log_line("notebook 01's own logic. The discrepancy may be in a part of the pipeline not covered here")
  log_line("(e.g. a difference between this run's environment/package versions and the one that")
  log_line("produced the original zero-match result) - consider re-running notebook 01 itself fresh.")
}
log_blank()
log_line("== How to Read This Log (section reference) ==")
log_line("Section A: cohort_hospitalization_ids integrity (duplicates, whitespace/case within itself)")
```
